rows.grounds: present participle of dā, referring to the one who gives
present participle of grah, referring to the one who receives
future form of bhū expressing inevitable consequence

items.question: What penalty threatens both the giver and receiver in mantra transmission?
premises: One party acts as the giver in transmission.
Another party acts as the receiver in transmission.
Improper transmission brings a curse upon the lineage.
items.inference: Both the giver and the receiver will incur a lineage curse.
uncertainties: The specific breach of proper transmission is implied from the preceding verses rather than stated explicitly in this verse.
items.plain_english: O goddess, a curse upon the lineage will befall both the one who gives and the one who receives.
